verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for an observability SaaS platform with an API and MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that CLI profiles store credentials and that nrdiag accepts an -api-key flag. Nothing documents creating keys with restricted permissions, scopes, or least-privilege roles for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
